BiblicalUsage: Old age is the word's whole meaning, and Scripture treats it both as a fact and as a promise. Sarah bears a son when Abraham is old, Solomon's heart turns in his old age, and God says, ‘even to your old age I am he.’ The years come for the faithful and the faithless alike — the difference is who carries them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God's promise to carry us to grey hairs is one of the tenderest in the Bible: He does not retire from His people when they grow old.
